entries.title: RetroArch PS5
entries.description: Multi-system emulator frontend (RetroArch / EmulationStation). ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4+ recommended. You must provide your own legally obtained game backups and system files.

entries.title: Castation (Dreamcast)
entries.description: Dreamcast emulator built around Flycast. IMPORTANT: ELF-based Homebrew Launcher app; requires manual extraction to /data/homebrew/Castation and launch using Homebrew Launcher. PS5 Library may only download this file, not install it. Supply your own games.

entries.title: Porpoise (GameCube / Wii)
entries.description: Native GameCube and Wii emulator based on Dolphin. Requires compatible PS5 homebrew environment and ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4+. Bring your own legally obtained game backups.

entries.title: PS5X360 (Xbox 360)
entries.description: Experimental native Xbox 360 emulator. Follow upstream setup and compatibility guides; no games, console firmware or keys included.

entries.title: XPSemu (Original Xbox)
entries.description: Experimental original Xbox emulator. Requires separate helper.elf loaded with kstuff, plus your own Xbox MCPX and BIOS dumps. Read the developer installation guide.

entries.title: PICO-8 PS5
entries.description: PS5 frontend for PICO-8. Requires a separately purchased PICO-8 Linux copy (pico8_dyn and pico8.dat); not included. Manual setup required.

entries.title: Ruffle Flash PS5
entries.description: Flash/SWF content emulator. Requires separate helper.elf loaded using kstuff and your own SWF content at /data/ruffle/games/. See upstream instructions.
